verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Card Expenses API built for accounting sync: it retrieves approved card expenses and marks them as synced once they are ingested into an ERP or accounting system. This sync still has to be built by a developer, and it covers card expenses only, so the story is delivered in part. missing for 10: native automatic connectors to accounting software (e.g. Xero/QuickBooks/NetSuite), documented automatic sync of general account transactions beyond card expenses, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software

citations.quote: The Card Expenses API lets you retrieve approved card expenses from Airwallex and mark them as synced after ingesting them into your ERP or accounting system.
Control, automate, and reconcile global company spend across expenses and accounts payable.
